titel: Exclusive: Chad Robertson Talks About His New Brooklyn Bakery

einzeiler: Chad Robertson announces his new Brooklyn bakery, Alt Bau, in a special bonus episode.
kurzfassung: Star baker Chad Robertson reveals exclusive details about his upcoming Brooklyn bakery and cafe project in a surprise bonus episode. Located in a freestanding Williamsburg building, the new venture will feature an all-day menu and an upstairs educational mill. Robertson explains that the concept, named Alt Bau, draws inspiration from the Bauhaus movement and focuses on fresh, small-batch offerings.
stichpunkte: Chad Robertson announces a new bakery project in Williamsburg, Brooklyn.
The project started as a consultation for a small sourdough pizza place before evolving into a larger endeavor.
The space is a freestanding building featuring giant windows, walnut floors, and a dedicated upstairs teaching and milling kitchen.
The bakery will operate as an all-day cafe with a focus on fresh, small-batch baking rather than overnight production.
The bakery is named Alt Bau, meaning old building, inspired partly by the Bauhaus movement's blend of art and craft.
Interior details include reclaimed old-growth walnut floors salvaged from an 1800s Long Island City bakery.

beschreibung:
A new Chad Robertson venture is always a big deal, and we have all the details.
In May, Jessica talked to the Tartine co-founder for our episode all about his bread and the enormous influence it has had on baking around the world. During that conversation, Chad talked at length about his forthcoming bakery and cafe in Brooklyn, Altbau. But those details weren’t quite ready for prime time when the episode came out. So we held that part of the conversation back — until now. Listen as Chad gives us all the delicious details about Altbau, including the story behind it, and a preview of what to expect.
This is a bonus episode of Things Bakers Know. We’re still on a between-season break, and will be back with more episodes in the fall. Until then, follow the recipe!
